previous_verse: Dawid and all the house of Israel played before YHWH with all manner of [instruments made of] fir wood, and with harps, and with stringed instruments, and with tambourines, and with castanets, and with cymbals.

current_text: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Uzzah; and Elohim struck him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of Elohim.
previous_verse: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put forth [his hand] to the ark of Elohim, and took hold of it; for the oxen stumbled.

current_text: Dawid was displeased, because YHWH had broken forth on Uzzah; and he called that place Peretz Uzzah, to this day.
previous_verse: The anger of YHWH was kindled against Uzzah; and Elohim struck him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of Elohim.

current_text: Dawid was afraid of YHWH that day; and he said, How shall the ark of YHWH come to me?
previous_verse: Dawid was displeased, because YHWH had broken forth on Uzzah; and he called that place Peretz Uzzah, to this day.

current_text: So Dawid would not remove the ark of YHWH to him into the city of Dawid; but Dawid carried it aside into the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite.
previous_verse: Dawid was afraid of YHWH that day; and he said, How shall the ark of YHWH come to me?

current_text: The ark of YHWH remained in the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite three months: and YHWH blessed Oved-Edom, and all his house.
previous_verse: So Dawid would not remove the ark of YHWH to him into the city of Dawid; but Dawid carried it aside into the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite.

current_text: It was told king Dawid, saying, YHWH has blessed the house of Oved-Edom, and all that pertains to him, because of the ark of Elohim. Dawid went and brought up the ark of Elohim from the house of Oved-Edom into the city of Dawid with joy.
previous_verse: The ark of YHWH remained in the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite three months: and YHWH blessed Oved-Edom, and all his house.

current_text: It was so, that, when those who bore the ark of YHWH had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
previous_verse: It was told king Dawid, saying, YHWH has blessed the house of Oved-Edom, and all that pertains to him, because of the ark of Elohim. Dawid went and brought up the ark of Elohim from the house of Oved-Edom into the city of Dawid with joy.

current_text: Dawid danced before YHWH with all his might; and Dawid was girded with a linen ephod.
previous_verse: It was so, that, when those who bore the ark of YHWH had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

current_text: It was so, as the ark of YHWH came into the city of Dawid, that Michal the daughter of Shaul looked out at the window, and saw king Dawid leaping and dancing before YHWH; and she despised him in her heart.
previous_verse: So Dawid and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of YHWH with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

current_text: When Dawid had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of YHWH of Armies.
previous_verse: They brought in the ark of YHWH, and set it in its place, in the midst of the tent that Dawid had pitched for it; and Dawid offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before YHWH.

current_text: Dawid said to Michal, [It was] before YHWH, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of YHWH, over Israel: therefore will I play before YHWH.
previous_verse: Then Dawid returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Shaul came out to meet Dawid, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!

current_text: It happened, when the king lived in his house, and YHWH had given him rest from all his enemies round about,
Then Dawid the king went in, and sat before YHWH; and he said, Who am I, YHWH God, and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
previous_verse: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Natan speak to Dawid.

current_text: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom Elohim went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make him a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeem to you out of Mitzrayim, [from] the nations and their gods?
previous_verse: Therefore you are great, YHWH Elohim: for there is none like you, neither is there any Elohim besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

current_text: Now, YHWH Elohim, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm you it forever, and do as you have spoken.
previous_verse: You did establish to yourself your people Israel to be a people to you forever; and you, YHWH, became their God.

current_text: For you, YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, I will build you a house: therefore has your servant found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
previous_verse: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, YHWH of Armies is Elohim over Israel; and the house of your servant Dawid shall be established before you.

current_text: Then Dawid put garrisons in Aram of Dammeseq; and the Syrians became servants to Dawid, and brought tribute. YHWH gave victory to Dawid wherever he went.
previous_verse: When the Syrians of Dammeseq came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, Dawid struck of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

current_text: These also did king Dawid dedicate to YHWH, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;
previous_verse: then Toi sent Yoram his son to king Dawid, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. [Yoram] brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

current_text: He put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to Dawid. YHWH gave victory to Dawid wherever he went.
previous_verse: Dawid got him a name when he returned from smiting the Syrians in the Valley of Salt, even eighteen thousand men.

current_text: The king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Shaul, that I may show the kindness of Elohim to him? Ziba said to the king, Yonatan has yet a son, who is lame of his feet.
previous_verse: There was of the house of Shaul a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to Dawid; and the king said to him, Are you Ziba? He said, Your servant is he.

current_text: Be of good courage, and let us play the person for our people, and for the cities of our God: and YHWH do that which seems him good.
previous_verse: He said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

current_text: When the mourning was past, Dawid sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son. But the thing that Dawid had done displeased YHWH.
previous_verse: When the wife of Uriyah heard that Uriyah her husband was dead, she made lamentation for her husband.

current_text: YHWH sent Natan to Dawid. He came to him, and said to him, "There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
He shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity!"
previous_verse: Dawid's anger was greatly kindled against the person, and they said to Natan, "As YHWH lives, the one who has done this is worthy to die!

current_text: Why have you despised the word of YHWH, to do that which is broken in his sight? You have struck Uriyah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
previous_verse: I gave you your master's house, and your master's wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Yehudah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

current_text: This is what YHWH says: 'Behold, I will raise up harm against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes, and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
previous_verse: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me, and have taken the wife of Uriyah the Hittite to be your wife.'

current_text: Natan departed to his house. YHWH struck the child that Uriyah's wife bore to Dawid, and it was very sick.
previous_verse: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to YHWH's enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you shall surely die."

current_text: Then Dawid arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the house of YHWH, and worshiped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he ate.
previous_verse: But when Dawid saw that his servants were whispering together, Dawid perceived that the child was dead; and Dawid said to his servants, Is the child dead? They said, He is dead.

current_text: He said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who knows whether YHWH will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?
previous_verse: Then said his servants to him, What thing is this that you have done? you did fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, you did rise and eat bread.

current_text: Dawid comforted Bat-Sheva his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her: and she bore a son, and he called his name Shlomo. YHWH loved him;
previous_verse: But now he is dead, why should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he will not return to me.

current_text: and he sent by the hand of Natan the prophet; and he named him Jedidiah, for YHWH's sake.
previous_verse: Dawid comforted Bat-Sheva his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her: and she bore a son, and he called his name Shlomo. YHWH loved him;

current_text: Then said she, Please let the king remember YHWH your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son. He said, As YHWH lives, there shall not one hair of your son fall to the earth.
previous_verse: The king said, Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and they shall not touch you any more.

current_text: For we must needs die, and are as water split on the ground, which can't be gathered up again; neither does Elohim take away life, but devises means, that the one who is banished not be an outcast from him.
previous_verse: The woman said, Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of Elohim? for in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again their banished one.

current_text: Behold, Tzadok also [came], and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of Elohim; and they set down the ark of Elohim; and Evyatar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
previous_verse: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

current_text: The king said to Tzadok, Carry back the ark of Elohim into the city: if I shall find favor in the eyes of YHWH, he will bring me again, and show me both it, and his habitation:
previous_verse: Behold, Tzadok also [came], and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of Elohim; and they set down the ark of Elohim; and Evyatar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

current_text: It happened that when Dawid had come to the top [of the ascent], where Elohim was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat torn, and earth on his head.
previous_verse: One told Dawid, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Avshalom. Dawid said, YHWH, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

current_text: The king said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because YHWH has said to him, Curse Dawid; who then shall say, Why have you done so?
previous_verse: Then said Avishai the son of Zeruiah to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head."

current_text: Dawid said to Avishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, who came forth from my bowels, seeks my life: how much more [may] this Benjamite now [do it]? let him alone, and let him curse; for YHWH has invited him.
previous_verse: The king said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because YHWH has said to him, Curse Dawid; who then shall say, Why have you done so?

current_text: It may be that YHWH will look on the wrong done to me, and that YHWH will requite me good for [his] cursing of me this day.
previous_verse: Dawid said to Avishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, who came forth from my bowels, seeks my life: how much more [may] this Benjamite now [do it]? let him alone, and let him curse; for YHWH has invited him.

current_text: Hushai said to Avshalom, No; but whom YHWH, and this people, and all the people of Israel have chosen, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
previous_verse: Avshalom said to Hushai, Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn't you go with your friend?

current_text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Tzadok, Let me now run, and bear the king news, how that YHWH has avenged him of his enemies.
previous_verse: Now Avshalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar, which is in the king's dale; for he said, I have no son to keep my name in memory: and he called the pillar after his own name; and it is called Avshalom's monument, to this day.

current_text: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, All is well. He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, Blessed be YHWH your God, who has delivered up the people who lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
previous_verse: The watchman said, I think the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Tzadok. The king said, He is a good man, and comes with good news.

current_text: He bowed the heart of all the people of Yehudah, even as [the heart of] one man; so that they sent to the king, [saying], Return you, and all your servants.
previous_verse: Say you to Amasa, Aren't you my bone and my flesh? Elohim do so to me, and more also, if you aren't captain of the army before me continually in the room of Yoav.

current_text: But Avishai the son of Zeruiah answered, Shall Shimei not be put to death for this, because he cursed YHWH's anointed?
previous_verse: For your servant does know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come this day the first of all the house of Yosef to go down to meet my lord the king.

current_text: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of Elohim: do therefore what is good in your eyes.
previous_verse: He answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for your servant said, I will saddle me a donkey, that I may ride thereon, and go with the king; because your servant is lame.

current_text: There was a famine in the days of Dawid three years, year after year; and Dawid sought the face of YHWH. YHWH said, It is for Shaul, and for his bloody house, because he put to death the Gibeonites.
let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to YHWH in Gibeah of Shaul, the chosen of YHWH. The king said, I will give them.
previous_verse: They said to the king, The one who consumed us, and who devised against us, [that] we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

current_text: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the mountain before YHWH, and they fell [all] seven together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
previous_verse: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Shaul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Shaul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

current_text: They buried the bones of Shaul and Yonatan his son in the country of Binyamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. After that Elohim was entreated for the land.
previous_verse: and he brought up from there the bones of Shaul and the bones of Yonatan his son: and they gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

current_text: Dawid spoke to YHWH the words of this song in the day that YHWH delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Shaul:
and he said, YHWH is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
previous_verse: Dawid spoke to YHWH the words of this song in the day that YHWH delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Shaul:

current_text: Elohim, my rock, in him I will take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
previous_verse: and he said, YHWH is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

current_text: Elohim makes his feet like hinds' [feet], and sets me on my high places.
previous_verse: Elohim is my strong fortress. Elohim makes my way perfect.

current_text: YHWH gives great deliverance to YHWH’s king, and shows loving kindness to YHWH’s anointed, to Dawid and to his seed, forevermore.
previous_verse: Therefore I will give thanks to you, YHWH, among the nations. Will sing praises to your name.

current_text: The Ruach of YHWH spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
previous_verse: Now these are the last words of Dawid. Dawid the son of Yishai says, the one who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Ya'akov, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

current_text: [He shall be] as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, [When] the tender grass [springs] out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.
previous_verse: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, one who rules over men righteously, who rules in reverence for God,

current_text: Most certainly my house is not so with Elohim, yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation, and all [my] desire, although he doesn't make it grow.
previous_verse: [He shall be] as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, [When] the tender grass [springs] out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.

current_text: He arose, and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and YHWH worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take spoil.
previous_verse: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with Dawid, when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the people of Israel were gone away.

current_text: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and YHWH worked a great victory.
previous_verse: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

current_text: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beit Lechem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to Dawid: but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to YHWH.
previous_verse: Dawid longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beit Lechem, which is by the gate!

current_text: He said, Be it far from me, YHWH, that I should do this: [shall I drink] the blood of the people who went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.
previous_verse: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beit Lechem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to Dawid: but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to YHWH.

current_text: Again the anger of YHWH was kindled against Israel, and he moved Dawid against them, saying, Go, number Israel and Yehudah.

Dawid's heart struck him after that he had numbered the people. Dawid said to YHWH, I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, YHWH, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.
previous_verse: Yoav gave up the sum of the numbering of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant people who drew the sword; and the people of Yehudah were five hundred thousand men.

current_text: Dawid said to Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of YHWH; for his mercies are great; and let me not fall into the human hand.
previous_verse: So Gad came to Dawid, and told him, and said to him, Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? or shall there be three days' pestilence in your land? now advise you, and consider what answer I shall return to the one who sent me.

current_text: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Yerushalayim to destroy it, YHWH relented from the harm, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, It is enough; now stay your hand. The angel of YHWH was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
previous_verse: So YHWH sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the time appointed; and there died of the people from Dan even to Be'er Sheva seventy thousand men.

current_text: Dawid spoke to YHWH when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father's house.
previous_verse: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Yerushalayim to destroy it, YHWH relented from the harm, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, It is enough; now stay your hand. The angel of YHWH was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

current_text: Gad came that day to Dawid, and said to him, Go up, rear an altar to YHWH in the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
previous_verse: Dawid spoke to YHWH when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father's house.

current_text: Araunah said, Why is my lord the king come to his servant? Dawid said, To buy the threshing floor of you, to build an altar to YHWH, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
previous_verse: Araunah looked forth, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

current_text: She said to him, My lord, you swore by YHWH your God to your handmaid, [saying], Assuredly Shlomo your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.
previous_verse: Bat-Sheva bowed, and did obeisance to the king. The king said, What would you?

current_text: most certainly as I swore to you by YHWH, the God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Shlomo your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place; most certainly so will I do this day.
previous_verse: The king swore, and said, As YHWH lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

current_text: As YHWH has been with my lord the king, even so be he with Shlomo, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king Dawid.
previous_verse: Benayahu the son of Yehoyada answered the king, and said, Amen: YHWH, the God of my lord the king, say so [too].

current_text: Moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king Dawid, saying, your God make the name of Shlomo better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne: and the king bowed himself on the bed.
previous_verse: Also Shlomo sits on the throne of the kingdom.

current_text: Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Yarden, and I swore to him by YHWH, saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.
previous_verse: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Avshalom your brother.

current_text: He said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: however the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's; for it was his from YHWH.
previous_verse: He said moreover, I have somewhat to tell you. She said, Say on.

current_text: Then king Shlomo swore by YHWH, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adoniyahu has not spoken this word against his own life.
previous_verse: King Shlomo answered his mother, Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adoniyahu? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Evyatar the priest, and for Yoav the son of Zeruiah.

current_text: Now therefore as YHWH lives, who has established me, and set me on the throne of Dawid my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, surely Adoniyahu shall be put to death this day.
previous_verse: Then king Shlomo swore by YHWH, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adoniyahu has not spoken this word against his own life.

current_text: So Shlomo thrust out Evyatar from being priest to YHWH, that he might fulfill the word of YHWH, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shilo.
previous_verse: To Evyatar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you bear the ark of YHWH God before Dawid my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.

current_text: The news came to Yoav; for Yoav had turned after Adoniyahu, though he didn't turn after Avshalom. Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
previous_verse: So Shlomo thrust out Evyatar from being priest to YHWH, that he might fulfill the word of YHWH, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shilo.

current_text: It was told king Shlomo, Yoav is fled to the Tent of YHWH, and behold, he is by the altar. Then Shlomo sent Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, saying, Go, fall on him.
previous_verse: The news came to Yoav; for Yoav had turned after Adoniyahu, though he didn't turn after Avshalom. Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

current_text: Benayahu came to the Tent of YHWH, and said to him, Thus says the king, Come forth. He said, No; but I will die here. Benayahu brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Yoav, and thus he answered me.
previous_verse: It was told king Shlomo, Yoav is fled to the Tent of YHWH, and behold, he is by the altar. Then Shlomo sent Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, saying, Go, fall on him.

current_text: YHWH will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father Dawid didn't know it, [to wit], Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Yehudah.
previous_verse: The king said to him, Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him; that you may take away the blood, which Yoav shed without cause, from me and from my father's house.

current_text: So shall their blood return on the head of Yoav, and on the head of his seed forever: but to Dawid, and to his seed, and to his house, and to his throne, shall there be peace for ever from YHWH.
